pages.name: Dirt Bee
pages.text: Lesser Bubba Star. Overworld, by day.

Its comb alone makes dirt. Mixed with other combs it makes podzol (taiga), coarse dirt (savanna), grass blocks (meadow), rooted dirt (lush caves) and soul soil (soul).$(br2)$(l)Flowers:$() Dirt, Coarse Dirt, Podzol, Rooted Dirt, Grass Block$(br2)$(l)Home biome:$() none$(br2)$(l)Brings home$() (busy hive):$(li)Dirt Honeycomb: every trip, 210 per hive-hour
Use it on a vanilla bee.
